name: Animate Studio
intro: Animate Studio brings a single image to life as a short video with AI motion. You add a picture, describe the movement, and choose the length.

features.source-upload-image: Start with the source. Upload image adds one picture, and a small preview appears under the picker once you've chosen it.
features.source-from-photo-studio: From Photo Studio lets you pick a photoshoot you already made there, so you can animate a branded product image without uploading again.
features.motion-prompt-and-suggestion-chips: The Motion Prompt box is where you describe the movement. Five suggestion chips fill it for you, like a slow pan or a gentle zoom.
features.duration-and-resolution: Two dropdowns set Duration, from three to twelve seconds, and Resolution, from 480p up to 1080p. Start small for quick tests.
features.model-seedance-lite-default-choose-a-mod: By default Animate Studio uses Seedance Lite. Switch to Choose a model to pick from a large list of image-to-video models for a different look.
features.advanced-model-fields: When you choose a model, advanced fields appear, like Negative Prompt and Seed, for steering the result and repeating it.
features.use-my-brand: Use My Brand lets you connect your business name, colors and logos through personalization, to keep your animations on brand.
features.result-and-animation-history: Your result appears with a player and a Download button, and Animation History keeps your recent animations close by.

outro: That's Animate Studio. Describe one motion at a time, test at low resolution, and a still image becomes a moving scene.
